original_benchmark.notes: Original release ships queries and rubrics plus an LLM-judge grader; responses come from any external system. Judge panel: claude-sonnet-4-6, gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gpt-5.4.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity on the 11-task --split parity subset (5%, stratified by use case), 3 runs per side, judged by claude-haiku-5-5, gemini-3.8-flash, gpt-6-luna on both sides. Oracle reports are constructed from rubrics; byte-identical oracle reports skip the judges.
